correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md, verify_pair_shuffling.py inspected. Each 2D row pair has residual rank-one projectors whose Frobenius product squared is c_j^(2 w) with w equal to number of row-label switches. SS has 2t−1 switches; FF t; RR t plus t−1 independent Bernoulli(1/2) switches, yielding h_j^(t−1). For IID the pair count K~Binomial(2Nt,1/N), with conditional E[c^(2w)|K≥1]=h^(K−1), K=0 gives 2, giving a_j,b_j finite formula. Jensen and c²≤h, h≥c prove finite inequalities. Monotone Riemann-sum error O(1/N), Laplace v=tλ scaling and exponential domination produce Γ(β+1)/(2(k t)^β) with t^β/N→0. Independent exact rational binomial pair calculation checked five (N,t,c) settings. These finite checks do not imply all-β limits; analytic domination does.

originality.rationale: 2026 Ahle–Bulatov–De Sa–Ré v2 is closest full text, deriving Gaussian-design spectral-edge β=1/2 error constants (SS/FF/IID) and a qualitative shuffling gap conjecture; its quantitative √2 in that model is neither asserted universal nor refuted. The audited coherent 2-row full-rank family has exact finite formulas including RR for any β>0, and gives exponent-indexed ratio 2^β. Two-factor rearrangement work of Yun–Sra–Jadbabaie and broad Liu RR convergence bounds do not imply these four traces and powerlaw constants.
residual_risks: General alternating-projection and stochastic-optimization literature may yield equivalent coherent-pair formulas; no guarantee from semantic searches.

value.rationale: The row-normalized fully consistent paired block family disentangles spectral-edge exponent from row-coherence geometry while giving exact finite constants for four widely used sampling policies; it quantifies a genuine dependence of the IID/SS advantage on β, an interpretable shuffling-performance benchmark rather than a textbook inequality.

final_claim: For paired-row unit-step Kaczmarz with spectral edge F_N(λ)=floor(Nλ^β)/(2N), arbitrary β>0, the SS, RR, FF, IID isotropic mean-square errors have exact finite N,t formulas and are ordered SS≤RR≤FF≤IID; jointly t,N→∞, t^β/N→0, leading constants Γ(β+1)/(2(k t)^β) with k=(4,3,2,2), so IID/SS→2^β.
limitations: Real square full-rank exactly consistent paired-row systems, isotropic second moment, unit relaxation, exact arithmetic; joint limit t,N→∞ with t^β/N→0, not fixed-N late epochs or dense arbitrary data.
residual_risks: General alternating-projection and stochastic-optimization literature may yield equivalent coherent-pair formulas; no guarantee from semantic searches.
